prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 86.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 94.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 72.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 93.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 84.1%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Voice & Personality Tuning Stage: Adds an interactive voice and behavior tuning screen before photo uploads where users select pitch, audio responses, and personality style. (why: The adoption step has 72.3% conversion and 1017s mean duration; giving users early voice and trait preview reduces customization friction.)
1: [home, redesign] Multi-Asset Desktop Live Render Stage Redesign: Redesigns the waiting screen into a split rendering stage displaying pet asset build stages and live system tray integration status. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s, and 3 support emails reported pets not opening or failing to display on the desktop.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Tray & Pet Control Sandbox Flow: Adds a hands-on control testing flow on the final screen where users practice summoning, dragging, and hiding the pet before ending onboarding. (why: Support received 3 emails on pet controls/hiding and 4 emails regarding desktop feature misbehavior after setup.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Certificate Cloud Safeguard Flow Reorder: Moves the sign-in step immediately after adoption certificate completion so users secure their newly named pet to a cloud account before asset rendering. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets upon signing in again later.)
4: [home, wait_info] Real-Time Desktop Render Activity Feed: Enables progress tracking and readiness notifications on the waiting screen while background assets render. (why: Users face long background wait times (mean 2336s) and uncertainty about when the desktop pet is ready to spawn.)
5: [finish, layout] Desktop Tray Access Spotlight Layout: Switches the final home intro screen to a spotlight layout focusing on system tray icon visibility and pet summon hotkeys. (why: Post-onboarding support contacts frequently ask how to locate, hide, or interact with their pet after setup.)
6: [adoption, copy] Custom Pet Asset Quality Safety Notice: Updates photo upload screen text with clear lighting and pose guidelines to prevent photo conversion errors. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted custom pet creation failures or poor rendering output.)
